question: Find the value of x satisfying: 3(2x² − 5) − 2(3x² + 4x − 8) = 20
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand the equation and cancel the x² terms directly:

⇒ 6x² − 15 − 6x² − 8x + 16 = 20

⇒ −8x + 1 = 20

⇒ −8x = 19

⇒ x = −19/8

**∴ The correct answer is −19/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

3(2x² − 5) − 2(3x² + 4x − 8) = 20

**Calculation:**

⇒ Expand the brackets by multiplying the outer numbers with each inner term:

⇒ (3 × 2x²) − (3 × 5) − (2 × 3x²) − (2 × 4x) − (2 × −8) = 20

⇒ 6x² − 15 − 6x² − 8x + 16 = 20

⇒ Group the like terms together:

⇒ (6x² − 6x²) − 8x + (−15 + 16) = 20

⇒ 0 − 8x + 1 = 20

⇒ −8x = 20 − 1

⇒ −8x = 19

⇒ x = −19/8

**∴ The correct answer is −19/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation in One Variable

An equation where the highest power of the variable is 1. It always has exactly one solution and is represented in the standard form: ax + b = 0.

BODMAS Rule

It dictates the order of mathematical operations: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Distributive Property

The rule states that a(b + c) = ab + ac. It is used to eliminate brackets by multiplying the outside term with every term inside.
